pages.title: Asian giant tortoise artificially incubated in Manipur

facts.text: Where: Manipur Zoological Garden, Imphal with India Turtle Conservation Program (ITCP)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Result: 28 hatchlings (August 2025) — ⚠ first artificial hatching of the species in mainland Asia
facts.head: News

facts.text: Training: 25 zookeepers and forest staff (21 August 2025)

facts.text: Persons: Director Laishram Biramangol Singh; ITCP coordinator Sushmita Kar

pages.title: National Designated Authority for carbon markets

facts.text: Notified: 22 August 2025 by MoEFCC
facts.head: News

facts.text: Why: mandatory under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement (2015)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Composition: 21 members, headed by Secretary, MoEFCC; MEA, MNRE, NITI Aayog, Steel Ministry etc.
facts.head: News

facts.text: Functions: list activities eligible for carbon credits; approve projects; allow credits to count toward NDCs
facts.head: News

facts.text: COP29 (Baku, Nov 2024): finalised Article 6 rules
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ITMOs: internationally transferred mitigation outcomes
facts.head: Background

facts.text: India's 2030 NDC: Emissions intensity of GDP; Target: cut 45% from 2005 levels
facts.head: Background

facts.text: India's 2030 NDC: Non-fossil installed capacity; Target: 50%
facts.head: Background

facts.text: India's 2030 NDC: Additional carbon sink; Target: 2.5–3 billion tonnes CO2e

pages.title: Vikalpa report on coal operations and NGT

facts.text: Report: "Regulating Coal Operations: Environmental and Social Impacts through the Lens of the National Green Tribunal" — by non-profit Vikalpa, 26 August 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Authors: Shripad Dharmadhikari, Kush Tanwani — analysed eight NGT cases
facts.head: News

facts.text: Coal share: coal and lignite 73% of electricity in 2022–23; ~50% by 2031–32
facts.head: News

facts.text: Air: coal dust PM10 up to five times limit (460 μg/m³)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Cases: Ennore (TN) — fly ash clogging, data manipulation, mangrove restoration order; Sonbhadra, Mejia — restoration committees
facts.head: News

facts.text: Health: silica (silicosis), cadmium, lead
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ NGT compensation often delayed or partial
facts.head: News

pages.title: Monsoon 2025 disasters and need for preventive resilience

facts.text: August 2025: floods in Punjab and Delhi; landslides in Himachal Pradesh; deaths in J&K
facts.head: News

facts.text: Pattern: rainfall in concentrated bursts; "compound disasters" (IPCC, IMD)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Issues: weak last-mile warnings; reactive relief; ⚠ compensatory afforestation does not restore same biodiversity
facts.head: News

facts.text: Plans: NAPCC, SAPCCs; NDMA/SDMA district plans
facts.head: News

facts.text: Global models: floodplain zoning (Netherlands), slope stabilisation (Japan), community preparedness (Philippines)
facts.head: News

pages.title: 33 years after the Rio Earth Summit

facts.text: Summit: UNCED, 1992, Rio — 125 countries, 100 heads of state, 12,000 delegates
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Outcomes: UNFCCC (in force 1994); CBDR principle in Rio Declaration; Biodiversity Convention; Desertification Treaty
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Binding Forest Convention was not adopted — blocked by Global South (G77, India); only non-binding forest principles
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Paris Agreement (2015): shift to voluntary NDCs
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Climate finance promise: $100 billion a year — unmet
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Commentators: Sunita Narain, Anumita Roychowdhury (CSE)
facts.head: Background
